en.headline: Driver arrested after light goods vehicle hits 72-year-old pedestrian in Tai Po
en.dek: The woman was knocked down at a pedestrian crossing on On Tai Road and remains unconscious in hospital; the 68-year-old driver faces a dangerous driving charge.
body: Police are investigating a traffic collision in Tai Po in which a 72-year-old woman was knocked down by a light goods vehicle and left unconscious.

Officers received a report at about 3.41 pm that a southbound vehicle on On Tai Road had turned left at the junction with On Pong Road and struck a pedestrian using the crossing. The victim, surnamed Cheung, sustained a head wound with bleeding and was taken by ambulance to Prince of Wales Hospital for emergency treatment.

A 68-year-old male driver, also surnamed Cheung, passed a breathalyser test but was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm. He is being held for further enquiries. Police appealed for witnesses or dashcam footage to assist the investigation.

zh.headline: 大埔輕型貨車撞傷72歲女途人 司機涉危險駕駛被捕
zh.dek: 事主於安泰路行人過路處被撞倒，頭部受傷昏迷送院；68歲男司機通過酒精測試後，因涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕。
body: 警方正調查大埔一宗交通意外，一名72歲女途人被輕型貨車撞倒後昏迷送院。
警方下午約3時41分接報，一輛沿安泰路南行的車輛於安邦路交界左轉時，懷疑撞到正在使用行人過路處的女子。事主姓張，頭部受傷流血，由救護車送往威爾斯親王醫院急救。
涉事68歲男司機同樣姓張，通過呼氣測試，但因涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害被捕，現正扣留調查。警方呼籲目擊者或有行車記錄儀片段的市民提供資料。
